requirement: The PM creates a note on an existing epic and the epic's note list then contains it with the exact text sent.
After the PM creates notes A then B on one epic, the list returns B before A (newest first).
The PM pins note A; the epic's note view then returns A first even though B is newer.
After the PM pins A and then pins B, at most one note of the epic is pinned.
A Developer who is a member of the project cannot create or edit a note (the request is rejected, not accepted).
A note text containing a script tag and a newline is returned unchanged as text.
Creating a note on an epic id that does not exist is rejected with a not-found result, not a server error.
Creating a note with empty text is rejected.
